response.evidence: The dataset contains no credit scores, rejection reasons, or applicant-level comparisons, so it cannot establish why any individual application was denied. Among the roughly 100+ White female applications, I count only about 8-9 denials (roughly 8%), which appears comparable to or lower than the overall denial rate. Denials also occur across Asian, Hispanic or Latino, Black or African American, and other groups, and denial rates are not clearly concentrated in any one group. The data shows no statistically meaningful pattern of discrimination against White female applicants, though it is too limited to rule out discrimination in your individual case.
